news.text: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) will play in Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.analysis: Emmanwori will be available to play on Sunday, which was to be expected after he practiced in a full capacity all week. He will continue to be a key contributor for this elite defense moving forward.

news.text: Mason Graham is expected to miss a few weeks with an MCL sprain.
news.analysis: Graham also suffered an ankle sprain in Thursday's win over the Steelers. It is a positive sign he was able to avoid a major injury.

news.text: Jayden Daniels (elbow) will not play Sunday against the Colts.
news.analysis: Daniels has been progressing this week from his elbow injury, even getting in some limited practice sessions. He's still not quite ready to go, however, as Marcus Mariota will draw a second straight start behind center. Daniels will look ahead to a Week 5 matchup against the Giants.
